purpose: Curated, source-linked notation evidence for AgentForge SRS diagrams. This file records facts and visual observations; it does not copy third-party images.
image_policy: Follow linked source images to learn notation and layout. Do not reproduce their artwork, branding, colours, or example domain content.

activity.visual_observation: The reference figures distinguish control nodes from actions; decisions and merges share a diamond, while parallel split/join use a bar.

accepted_notation: dashed message flow only between pools
bpmn.visual_observation: Pool and lane containers make responsibility visible; events, tasks and gateways remain visually distinct.

sources.title: Visual Paradigm — UML Class Diagram Tutorial

accepted_notation: attribute and return types after colon
class_object.visual_observation: The tutorial images separate class and object values, show member compartments, and use connector end symbols rather than colour to convey relationship meaning.

component.visual_observation: Components and their interfaces are separate visual concepts: supplied services use a lollipop and required services use a socket.

sources.title: Microsoft — Create a UML Deployment Diagram

deployment.visual_observation: Reference figures place artifacts inside their deployment node; containment conveys where software runs.

dfd.visual_observation: A DFD uses different shapes for entity, process and store; arrows describe named data, not control actions.

erd.visual_observation: Entity boxes retain field detail while Crow's Foot endpoint marks, not arrow direction, communicate cardinality.

sequence.visual_observation: Time reads top-to-bottom; activation rectangles align with a participant's lifeline and returns are visibly dashed.

state_machine.visual_observation: States are stable conditions; arrows are labelled events/triggers, with pseudostates visually separate from ordinary states.

accepted_notation: external actors and systems outside the boundary
system_context.visual_observation: The system is central and opaque; surrounding entities indicate environment, not internal implementation.

sources.title: Visual Paradigm — Use Case Diagram Notation

use_case.visual_observation: Actors remain outside the system boundary, goals are ellipses inside it, and include/extend are labelled dashed dependencies.
